note: people_id to VoteApp candidate id for Utah. One file covers BOTH sessions in scope, the 2025 General Session (LegiScan 2137) and the 2026 General Session (2214), because LegiScan people_ids are stable across sessions: 101 of the 104 members appear in both files with the same name and seat, and the two resolve runs proposed the same candidate for every person they both matched, with no conflict. The union is 107 people: three left after 2025 (Jefferson Moss HD-051, Daniel Thatcher SD-011, Gay Lynn Bennion HD-041) and three arrived for 2026 (Leah Hansen, Emily Buss, John Arthur). 72 are mapped: 69 proposed by the resolver and accepted after checking each seat, and 3 added by hand where the ballot prints a nickname or an initial the proposer cannot reach. Two proposals disagree on seat and both are real: Jill Koford (HD-010) and Doug Fiefia (HD-048) are sitting representatives running for open Senate seats, corroborated against both ballots. 35 are explicit nulls with the reason in each note: 14 senators whose seats are not on the 2026 ballot, 6 senators whose seats are up but who are not on the ballot, 12 representatives not on the ballot, and the 3 who left. Five nulls carry a do-not-link note because our roster holds a different person with the same surname.
